name: Trip planner
oneLine: A day-by-day trip plan you can actually follow.
forWho: Anyone planning a city trip who wants a calm plan, not a packed list.
youGet: Two or three stops a day, close together
A map link and a rain plan for every day
Rough costs and a packing list you can tick
woah: Every day opens as a walking route in Google Maps.
whyBetter: Plain Claude packs every hour and invents places. This keeps days near one area, shows travel time, and flags what to check first.
tryPrompt: Plan 4 days in Lisbon in May for me and my partner. Mid budget. We like food and walking, not museums.
